for i = 1, 41 do
    local door1 = game.workspace.Doors[tostring(i)].Door1
   
    local scriptName = "???"

    if door1 then
        -- Check if a script named "???" exists inside Door1
        local scriptInDoor1 = door1:FindFirstChild(scriptName)
        
        if scriptInDoor1 then
            -- If the script exists, set Door1 to Bright green
            game.workspace.Doors[tostring(i)].Door1.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")

    end
end
